verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v1: ʾakhayālu ḥawwā zāranī ʿinda l-karā fī mawhini fajarā dumūʿu maḥājirī
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v2: ʾabkī bukāʾa ḥamāmati qumriyyati faqadat hadīlā fawqa ghuṣni nādiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v3: ʾinshāduhā yasrī biṣādiqi wajdihā lis-sāmiʿīna wakulli ṣabbi ṣādiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v4: bātat tanūḥu ʿalā l-hadīli fabittu ʾab kī dāʾimā ʾithra l-khayāli z-zāʾiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v5: badriyyatu fī ghurrati durriyyati fī bahjahi fattānati lin-nāẓiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v6: ʿūdu bakā min shawqihi liwiṣālihi washakā l-baʿīru ʾilā n-nabiyyī ṭ-ṭāhiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v7: fakhru līʾādama ʾidh bihi nāla s-siyā data bil-ʿulūmi ʿalā l-wujūdi ẓ-ẓāhiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v8: fafidāʾukum ʾummī waʿammī ʿammatī khālī wakhālātī ʾabī bal sāʾirī
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v11: thābat ʿuqūlu baʿda mā dhahabat bihā ʾaydī l-ghiwāyati bil-bashīri n-nādiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v12: thārat bika l-ʾanwāru thumma talāṭamat fī baḥri qalbi lil-muḥibbi l-ḥāʾiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v13: ẓamaʾī liwaṣlika dāʾimā lā ʾartawī ʾabadā bidūnika jud biwaṣli jābiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v14: ẓannī jamīlu fīka yā khayra l-warā ḥāshāka min raddi l-kasīri l-bāʾiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v15: ghārat miyāhu l-kufri thumma tasāqaṭat ʾawthānu makkaha yā liʾamri zājiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v16: ghasalat yamīnu r-rūḥi qalbaka fāntaqā wāzdāda nūrā fawqa nūri wāfiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v9: tallāhi qad madaḥatka ʾāyātu l-kitā bi faʾayna minhā madḥu qawli sh-shāʿiri
verses.akhayalu-hawwa-zarani-inda-l-kara-c1-v10: tallāhi ʾinna l-ʾanbiyāʾa tawassalū bika wal-malāʾiku bin-nabiyyī ẓ-ẓāfiri
